takesYou.hold: the hold that posted the bounty

takesYou.hold: the hold that posted the bounty
takesYou.why: collect the bounty from the steward or the jarl

Collect the bounty from the steward (or from the jarl)

rewards.what: An item from Requiem's giant-bounty reward list

people.name: The hold's jarl
people.role: pays the bounty if there's no steward to ask

unsure.why: The quest is started by the game on entering a new place, and the rules that decide when it fires (level, story progress, how often) aren't in these files.
LoreRim also has separate per-hold bounty quests (a giant bounty for Eastmarch, the Pale and Whiterun); the records don't show whether the game now picks those instead of this one.
The gold amount and what's in the reward list aren't in these files.
The lair is chosen when the quest starts, so no fixed place is in the records.
The quest carries a bounty letter and the hold's innkeeper, so the notice probably comes from the innkeeper or as a letter; the records don't show which.
Where the steward or jarl stands depends on the hold; the quest only names them by role.
